title: Python: TDMA Slots and Hash Selection oracle implementation
description:
TDMA Slots and Hash Selection Python oracle - implements spec/02a-tdma.md

## Extracted Requirements (MUST/SHALL/SHOULD)

### Slot Computation
- MUST: slot = hash_32(EUI64 XOR SFN) % n_slots (FNV-1a32, basis 0x811c9dc5)
- MUST: All results match test/vectors/ccp_tdma.json exactly

### Drift Compensation
- MUST: Apply drift compensation before slot calculation
- MUST: drift_ppm = (delta_ms * 1000000) / beacon_interval_ms
- MUST: Threshold >5000ppm triggers desync

### Beacon Processing
- MUST: Verify Schnorr signature before considering any field
- MUST: Silently discard beacons with invalid/missing signatures
- MUST: Prefer beacon with higher stratum (lower numerical value)
- MUST: At equal strata, prefer lowest IID (64-bit unsigned)

### Join FSM
- MUST: Implement beacon sync mode
- MUST: Follow lichen_node_init() ordering
- MUST NOT: Switch roots more than once per superframe
- MUST NOT: While DRIFTING, adopt beacons unless better stratum

### After Root Switch
- MUST: Send new DAO with new parent
- MUST: Reset SFN relative to new root epoch

### Optional/Recommended
- SHOULD: Re-evaluate root preference on better stratum beacon
- RECOMMENDED: GPS-sync when hardware available
